operations.abstract: A degree-4 K3 compactified-Picard pair gives a genuine twisted/untwisted derived near-miss, but unequal Neron-Severi discriminants prove that it is not birational and hence not K-equivalent.
operations.content: Let S be a very general complex projective K3 surface with Pic(S)=Z H and H^2=4, and let C -> |H| be the universal genus-3 curve. Set X=M_H(0,H,0)=\overline{Pic}^{2}(C/|H|) and Y=M_H(0,H,1)=\overline{Pic}^{3}(C/|H|). The Mukai vectors are primitive of square 4, so standard moduli theory for stable sheaves on a K3 surface makes X and Y smooth projective irreducible holomorphic symplectic sixfolds; in particular K_X=K_Y=0. Mattei--Meinsma, arXiv:2404.16652v2, Theorems 1.2/4.5, identifies the order of the obstruction to a universal sheaf with the Mukai-lattice divisibility. In N(S)=U plus <4>, div(0,H,0)=4 while div(0,H,1)=1, so the obstruction classes alpha_2 and alpha_3 have orders 4 and 1. Addington--Donovan--Meachan, J. Lond. Math. Soc. 93 (2016), Proposition 2.1(a), gives D^b(X,alpha_2^3) equivalent to D^b(Y); the twist alpha_2^3 is nontrivial of order 4. Nevertheless X and Y are not untwisted derived equivalent: Mattei--Meinsma, Theorem 5.17, applies directly, and its obstruction is the unequal discriminant of the algebraic part of Beckmann's extended Mukai lattice, namely 4 for X and 16 for Y; Beckmann, Compos. Math. 159 (2023), Theorem 9.2, proves that an untwisted exact derived equivalence would preserve this integral Hodge lattice. Crucially, this is not a counterexample to K-equivalence. Direct Mukai-morphism computation gives NS(X) Gram matrix [[0,-1],[-1,0]] of determinant -1 and NS(Y) Gram matrix [[0,-4],[-4,4]] of determinant -16. Birational projective irreducible symplectic manifolds have isometric integral H^2 Hodge lattices, hence isometric Neron-Severi lattices (Huybrechts, Invent. Math. 135 (1999), Corollary 4.7). Therefore X and Y are not birational, so no common birational resolution exists and they are not K-equivalent despite both canonical bundles being trivial. This eliminates this natural Brauer-twist mechanism: twisted equivalence plus failure of untwisted equivalence can occur, but in this explicit family the necessary birationality checkpoint fails.

operations.abstract: Counterexample search update: K3^[n]-type twisted candidates are closed off; generalized Kummer and O'Grady types remain more plausible stress-test pools.
operations.content: The root statement is exactly Kawamata's D/K-equivalence conjecture and remains open in full dimension, as recorded in active memo M-21853103147c48109c5dc4d16f83df43. The quartic-K3 compactified-Picard computation shows why a twisted Fourier--Mukai equivalence cannot be treated as evidence for a counterexample until birationality is checked: the pair has K=0 and genuine untwisted derived inequivalence, yet its NS discriminants differ and it is not birational. Moreover, Maulik--Shen--Yin--Zhang, Invent. Math. (2025), DOI 10.1007/s00222-025-01339-8, prove that all birational hyperkahler varieties of K3^[n]-type are derived equivalent, so no K-equivalent counterexample can come from that deformation type. A remaining systematic disproof search should instead examine generalized Kummer and O'Grady deformation types (or high-dimensional non-toroidal flops), enforcing four separate gates: smooth projective models, actual birationality/common resolution, crepantness, and an invariant of the full untwisted category. Yang, arXiv:2510.16279, supplies a new derived-invariant integral lattice for generalized Kummer varieties that could be computed on explicit birational wall-crossing models, but currently gives no counterexample and no general D-equivalence theorem.

progress_since_previous: Constructed and rigorously rejected a concrete Brauer-twisted compactified-Picard near-counterexample, with exact lattice computations staged reproducibly; narrowed the remaining counterexample search away from K3^[n]-type hyperkähler varieties.
